requirements_slice.system_goal: Upgrade the existing backend active slice from partial GRACE structure to dense, trace-first development observability without changing business semantics.

in_scope.item: Patch the existing backend active-slice module cluster for remaining module contract, module map, function contract, and semantic block gaps.

Add dense development-phase structured observability on exported, orchestration, and side-effect boundaries in backend/app/main.py, backend/app/logging_utils.py, backend/app/middleware/correlation.py, backend/app/services/day_brief.py, backend/app/services/day_brief_validators.py, backend/app/services/week_brief_service.py, backend/app/services/scheduler.py, and backend/app/services/analytics.py.
Keep packet-local read-only evidence separate from the final canonical today-week observability lane.
Materialize feature-local slice docs and replace the oversized single-wave feature packet graph.

out_of_scope.item: Changing DayBrief, WeekBrief, report-read, scheduler, analytics, scoring, auth, billing, or referral business semantics.
Repo-wide logging cleanup or a new logging transport.
Retroactive full decomposition of backend/app/main.py beyond the approved active-slice blocks.

use_case.summary: Prepare the existing backend active slice for deep refactor by closing strict-GRACE structure gaps and making runtime evidence trace-first and reviewable.
use_case.scenario: Targeted backend active-slice files expose stable module contracts, module maps, function contracts where required, and semantic START/END blocks.
Day, Week, gateway, and report-read execution paths emit dense structured markers on entry, major steps, fallbacks, validation boundaries, exception conversion, and closeout.
Scheduler and analytics paths emit attributable persistence, branch, and failure markers when exercised, or the non-emission gap is explicitly classified.
Verifier and reviewer can reconstruct the relevant scenario history from module/function/block names plus correlation and trace identifiers without guesswork.

business_invariants.invariant: No DayBrief, WeekBrief, report-read, scheduler, analytics, auth, billing, or scoring business semantics change in this slice.
Within backend/app/main.py only API_GATEWAY_APP_INIT, API_GATEWAY_REPORT_ORCHESTRATION, API_REPORT_DETAIL_ROUTE, API_TODAY_ROUTE, API_DAY_BRIEF_ROUTE, and API_B2C_REPORT_ROUTE are in scope.
Structured observability must reuse log_grace_event(...) and build_grace_log_payload(...) with the current correlation/header model; no new transport or envelope is allowed.
Dense logging is required on exported, orchestration, and side-effect boundaries, not as blanket noise in every pure helper.
backend/app/services/day_brief_validators.py remains a pure validation/repair helper; caller boundaries own observability for validation entry and failure.
Packet-local read-only evidence cannot close the slice; the final canonical today-week lane owns the wave-final observability verdict.

expected_failure_handling.item: Logging emission or JSONL routing failure must not block API, service, or scheduler completion.
Validation, fallback, retry, persistence-boundary, exception-conversion, and closeout branches must emit explicit markers without changing response semantics.
If packet-local runs do not naturally emit scheduler or analytics paths, the packet must record the evidence gap explicitly instead of claiming clean coverage.
W03 is blocked on no-evidence-blocker or unexpected-degradation from the canonical today-week observability review.

success_criteria.criterion: Remaining contract, map, function-contract, and semantic-block gaps are closed across the targeted backend active-slice files without widening scope.
Development-critical entry, major-step, branch, fallback, retry, persistence, exception-conversion, and closeout markers exist on the targeted runtime boundaries.
backend:quick and the targeted active-slice pytest bundle remain green.

Packet-local read-only review can follow emitted Day, Week, report-read, scheduler, and analytics traces by module, function, block, event, correlation_id, and trace_id where those paths are exercised.
The final canonical today-week review returns clean or degraded-but-expected with explicit rationale; unexpected-degradation or no-evidence-blocker blocks acceptance.
Scheduler or analytics non-emission, when a canonical run does not exercise those paths, is explicit and reviewer-visible rather than silent.
